item.title: Preseterizer 0.1.0
item.description:
• Make preset packs for Current and Serum 2 on this Mac: Mutations (variations and hybrids of your seeds) or a Ladder (each seed from close to super weird). A ladder seed with no macro knob free for the weird macro still gets its ladder, without it (Settings can skip those seeds instead).
  • Seeds: drop presets or folders, or use a synth's whole library, all of it or a sample that's saved with the pack. Bass by default; packs Preseterizer made stay out unless you switch them in.
  • Packs are made in the background, one at a time, and wait while your DAW plays. Quitting pauses one; it carries on next time.
  • Each pack installs straight into its synth. If the synth's folder isn't writable, Preseterizer asks once for your password.
  • Review a pack: play each preset and its weird macro, ✕ the misses (they go to the Trash and never come back), tick the best and use them as seeds.
  • Notes per pack, and Copy for Claude for the next change to the generator.
  • GitHub backup (Settings, off): each pack, its previews and notes as a release.
